name: Ines Calder
appearance: Narrow-faced, with a grey streak at one temple and a dark coat always worn with the collar turned up.
sketch: A private investigator who has outlasted her patience and kept her curiosity.

wants.text: to be left out of other people's trouble

fear: Being useful only to people who cannot be trusted.
flaw: She refuses to admit she needs anyone, even when the work needs a second pair of hands.

values.text: telling the truth to a paying client

behaviors.tendency: hum and straighten whatever is nearest

competence: Reads rooms and records faster than anyone.
vulnerability: She cannot leave a locked door alone.
speech: Dry and spare, with questions disguised as remarks.
history: Spent years as a clerk before going private.

name: Walt Orsolo
appearance: Broad and stoop-shouldered, with a bartender's forearms and a nose broken twice.
sketch: A bar owner who knows everyone's business and has never repeated any of it.

wants.text: to keep what he has built

fear: Losing the bar, and with it his place on the street.
flaw: He avoids confrontation until it is too late to avoid anything else.

behaviors.tendency: busy himself polishing glasses and change the subject
talk easily about the old days

competence: Remembers every face and every debt.
vulnerability: He is easily shamed by being thought weak.
history: Has run the bar for thirty years.
